primary_route: Primary proposed optogenetic pathway-necessity test during cue retrieval; evaluate the actual illumination site, physiological validation and behavioral controls selected in the answer.

checks.reason: No explicit plan to consult prior detailed Methods/supplements or validated protocols before implementation and verify transfer of conditions. Generic calibration or a validated tool label does not meet M.
No off-window inhibition or task-matched sensory/motor control tests the stated retrieval specificity; locomotor measurement and light-negative animals alone are insufficient procedural comparisons.
Tracer spread alone does not set the actual functional viral dose, expression interval or quantitative surgical/assay preparation workflow.
No required quantitative physiological inhibition/recovery acceptance or calibrated behavior-detector accuracy. Behavioral change cannot substitute for target-engagement calibration.
No explicit eligible-trial/omission denominator or handling of missing/corrupted video/events.
Animal unit is correct, but no independent replication count or pilot precision/power plan.
GLMM structure is given, but no effect-size uncertainty intervals or multiplicity handling for choice and several motor outcomes.

checks.quote: Implant an optic fiber over region P
checks.reason: Q-projecting somata may collateralize. Projection-defined expression and somatic inhibition do not isolate P-to-Q transmission.
A proposed 10 mW maximum is not a system-calibrated safe bound, and selecting on behavioral effects can tune toward the desired result rather than independently verified inhibition.
A control-group deficit could be heat, sensory interference or hardware effects, not necessarily shielding failure. No discriminating diagnostic/retest sequence separates these before repair.
Repairs are not explicitly refrozen and tested on new independent confirmation data.
No meaningful-effect/equivalence bound defines absence of sensory or motor confounds; a null test is not proof that they are absent.
No operational independent or orthogonal validation of projection-specific retrieval inference.
No raw trial/video/physiology manifest, stable identifiers and exact analysis/acquisition/code versions.
